_note: Core book: mentor spirits (p. 174) and Jet Setter (p. 139). Ratings assume this is the character's first Quality (base 0); otherwise +3 rating / +15,000¥. Mentor spirits are for Awakened characters and come with a Disposition the follower must reflect.

entries.name: Bear
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Survival (first aid), Close Combat (unarmed), Sorcery (health spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Rage: when wounded, throws themself into combat with no thought for safety.

entries.name: Cat
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Athletics (parkour), Stealth (physical sneaking), Sorcery (illusion spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Cruel: prefers to weaken and toy with prey rather than kill outright, while unwounded.

entries.name: Coyote
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Influence (impersonation), Influence (etiquette), Sorcery (manipulation spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Mischievous: never passes up a chance to trick someone, even to the team's detriment.

entries.name: Dog
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Perception (physical), Survival (navigation), Sorcery (detection spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Loyal: won't betray companions or let anyone sacrifice themselves for them.

entries.name: Dragonslayer
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Influence (intimidation), Close Combat (one specialization of your choice), Sorcery (combat spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Honor: does everything to keep their promises.

entries.name: Raccoon
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Stealth (palming), Influence (bluff), Sorcery (manipulation spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Curious: willing to ignore danger to uncover new secrets.

entries.name: Thunderbird
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Influence (intimidation), Close Combat (unarmed), Conjuring (spirits of air).
entries.grantsDisposition: Uptight: can't let an insult go unanswered.

entries.name: Wolf
entries.description: RR 1 on 2 of: Survival (navigation), Close Combat (unarmed), Close Combat (blades), Sorcery (combat spells).
entries.grantsDisposition: Fierce: never flees a fight once engaged.

entries.name: Jet Setter
entries.description: Used to the sharpest banter; social armor 1.
